callees.name: _iter_project_source_files
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is an existing directory path; submodules, if not None, is a non-empty sequence of subdirectory paths relative to proj_dir
callees.post_condition: Yields normalized forward-slash relative file paths for all project source files discoverable under proj_dir. When submodules is not None, yields only files whose paths fall under at least one of the specified submodule directories.

callees.name: _is_test_file
callees.pre_condition: rel is a normalized forward-slash relative file path string
callees.post_condition: Returns True if and only if rel identifies a test file; returns False for all other project source files.
